items.notes: NVIDIA 24GB GGUF (IQ2_XXS experts, NVFP4 Mamba, Q8_0 rest) + BF16 mmproj, fully on ONE B70 (0000:0f:00.0, as-found 230 W cap). llama-server, C1, greedy, thinking off, cold prompt, no drafter (Bolt ships no MTP head; NVIDIA's DFlash drafter decodes slower on SYCL: 25.7 vs 28.1). Env GGML_SYCL_GROUPED_MAX_ROWS=0. Numbers are llama-server `timings` (engine prefill and decode). 6/6 greedy smoke answers byte-identical to stock llama.cpp; KLD vs stock F32 logits 0.00139. Self-reported, one host, not independently reproduced. 886-token prompt, 128 generated tokens, mean of 3 runs after 1 warmup. Native GGML_SYCL_F16=ON build of the patched source on host compute-runtime 26.05. Stock 620d2225c (GGML_SYCL_F16 off, -b 2048) on the same prompt: 300.6 prefill / 28.1 decode. llama-bench (5 reps median, same flags both builds): pp8192 664.1 -> 1430.7 tok/s stock -> patched.
